entities.name: 3-dehydroquinate synthase
observations: The 328-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein Q2FQ51.
The enzyme belongs to the DHQS family and contains Pfam DHQS (PF01959) at residues 1-141 and DHQS_2nd (PF26558) at residues 154-328.

entities.name: DHQS oxidative deamination and cyclization
observations: The enzyme converts 2-amino-2,3,7-trideoxy-D-lyxo-hept-6-ulosonate plus NAD(+) and water to 3-dehydroquinate plus ammonium, NADH, and a proton.

entities.name: NAD+
observations: NAD(+) is the redox cofactor consumed in the DHQS reaction and is regenerated as NADH.

entities.name: Aromatic amino acid biosynthesis
observations: The product 3-dehydroquinate feeds the canonical shikimate pathway leading to aromatic amino acid biosynthesis.
